title: In the media: Quad prints World Series publications for hometown Brewers’ first title
summary: See how Quad helped commemorate the Brewers' first World Series championship through official MLB programs and keepsakes featured in the news.
body_markdown:
When the Milwaukee Brewers captured their franchise’s first World Series championship, fans across Wisconsin looked for ways to celebrate and remember the moment.


Quad has played an important role in helping preserve that historic season as the printer of a variety of World Series-related publications, including[the official MLB World Series Program](https://www.quad.com/newsroom/quad-prints-hometown-brewers-world-series-programs) , the newly released 2026 MLB Official World Series Program – Commemorative Edition, championship special magazines and a special Brewers-focused December issue of Milwaukee Magazine.


The official MLB commemorative edition was created in response to extraordinary demand from Brewers fans following the team’s championship run. Printed and bound at Quad’s Sussex facility, the publication gives fans another opportunity to own a keepsake celebrating the franchise’s first World Series title.


The work builds on Quad’s 25-year relationship with Major League Baseball, during which the company has served as MLB’s exclusive printer for the All-Star Game, League Championship Series and World Series programs.


## Quad’s role gains media attention


Quad’s work has generated significant media interest throughout the Brewers’ postseason run.


### Here’s what they’re saying:


- **


[Exclusive: First-look as Quad prints official Brewers-Rays World Series program](https://wtmj.com/news/2026/10/20/exclusive-first-look-as-quad-prints-official-brewers-rays-world-series-program/) – WTMJ went behind the scenes at Quad’s Sussex facility, showcasing production of the official World Series Program and featuring insights from Rick Cowan on the excitement surrounding the Brewers’ championship season.


- **


[Quad Prints Historic Brewers 2026 World Series Programs](https://www.baseballbiographies.com/quad-prints-historic-brewers-2026-world-series-programs/) – Baseball Biographies highlighted Quad’s role in producing official World Series publications and commemorative keepsakes celebrating the Brewers’ title run.


- **


[World Series: Programs printed, available for purchase](https://www.fox6now.com/video/fmc-kx46277fy6afqjbf) – Fox 6 featured coverage of the official World Series Program and its availability for fans looking to commemorate the season.


As Brewers fans continue celebrating the franchise’s first World Series title, Quad’s work has become part of the story, helping transform a championship season into keepsakes that fans can revisit for years to come.
